ios.desc:
Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is the simplest and fastest app to manage your budgets, track your expenses, and save money on the go.

Take control of your budget by allocating your expenses into different envelopes such as groceries, salary, fuel, hobbies, shopping, vacations, and more. Whether it's recurring expenses or special events, Tracky lets you track your monthly or one-time budgets.

Track your expenses and make the most of your savings with Tracky’s automatic calculation of your remaining budget. This fast and easy budget tracking tool is suitable for everyone, regardless of their expertise in budget management. Rest assured, Tracky doesn't require any connection to your bank account, ensuring your data and privacy remain secure.

Why should you use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker?

- Quick and easy
- Free
- Allocate your budget
- Track your expenses
- Enjoy your savings
- No sign-up or login required
- No bank account needed
- Private & secure: we don't collect your data, it's safe for you
- Automatic iCloud sync to share data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account

=== TRACKY: SIMPLE BUDGET TRACKER FEATURES ===

- Create and manage your budgets
- Add and customize your operations: name, amount, date, icon, color
- Automatic calculation of your remaining budget
- Stay informed about your budget's progress with notifications
- Keep a history of your expenses
- Save time by reusing recurring budgets
- Easily share your data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account
- Widgets: instantly monitor your budget from your lock screen and home screen

How to use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker:

1. Create a budget and give it a name (e.g., "July")
2. Define and customize your envelopes (e.g., "Groceries," "Fuel," "Hobbies")
3. Add your expenses to the envelopes
4. Enter the expense name and amount
5. Personalize the expense by selecting an icon and color
6. Continue adding your expenses as you go, and Tracky will calculate the remaining budget

As you can see, Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is incredibly simple and fast to use. It's the perfect solution for tracking your expenses and budgets without wasting time on understanding the app or linking your bank account, which could compromise your data. Managing your expenses has never been easier, faster, and more efficient.

quotes.text:
My Expenses is a very simple app to track expenses for one-time budgets.

Let's say you're going on vacations in Italy and you want to allocate $1.500 to this trip. You create a budget "Italy" in 30 seconds and you're ready to go. 
Each time you make an expense in Italy, you add it to the app in a few seconds and you instantly know you're remaining budget.

I'm bored of super complex apps. Yes, they do a lot of things, but it often takes a while to get used to the app and understand all its features.

That's why I created this app. 
I want people to be able to track their expenses in seconds, as quickly and simply as possible.

It's available on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
